name: ComfyUI
description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
one_liner: A visual, drag-and-drop tool for generating images, videos, and audio with AI models, running on your own computer instead of a monthly subscription service.
buyer: A small e-commerce store owner who can't afford a professional product photographer, or a freelance video editor who needs B-roll and can't license stock footage for every project.
business_use_cases: An Etsy or Shopify seller generates lifestyle product photography locally instead of paying $50-200 per photoshoot.
A freelance video editor builds custom ComfyUI workflows to generate b-roll and background assets for client videos, undercutting stock footage subscriptions.
A local ad agency offers 'AI visual assets' as a cheap add-on service to small business clients who can't afford a photo shoot.

money_ideas.idea: Build a 'product photography as a service' shop: clients send a plain product photo, you return 10 styled lifestyle shots using a ComfyUI workflow, billed per order.
Sell packaged ComfyUI workflow templates (e.g. 'Etsy product photo pack') on a marketplace.
Offer a subscription 'unlimited AI product photos' plan for small e-commerce stores, run on your own ComfyUI server.

steal_this: Build a one-weekend Shopify/Etsy add-on: a form where a seller uploads one plain product photo and a ComfyUI workflow returns five styled lifestyle images, sold per batch.
